key_insight: The study creates the first large-scale spin-polarized electronic-structure and bonding database for over 2,500 stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compounds with visible-range band gaps and half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset helps materials engineers rapidly screen double perovskites for solar, photocatalytic, and magnetic device applications by linking composition to electronic and bonding properties.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations of spin-polarized DOS for Cs2BB'X6 compounds
Lobster chemical-bonding analysis to probe orbital interactions
UMAP visualizations plus an interactive app for composition and property exploration
evidence_signal: The abstract reports computed data for more than 2,500 compounds, including 719 with visible band gaps and 118 half-metals, backed by hybrid-functional DFT and bonding analysis.
watch_item: Screening is based on predicted stability and computed properties, so experimental validation is still needed before device integration.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
